summary: This process details how to assign various roles to employees for a specific class, including Class Teacher, Coordinator, and Subject Teacher. It also clarifies the access levels associated with each role.
steps: Navigate to the class mapping for which you want to assign teachers (e.g., Class 5th, Section A).
To assign a "Class Teacher": Select an employee from the list and set them as the Class Teacher.
To assign a "Coordinator": Select one or more employees from the list and set them as Coordinators.
To assign a "Subject Teacher": For each subject listed in the class mapping, select one or more employees from the list to be the Subject Teacher(s) for that specific subject.
business_rules: Only one "Class Teacher" can be assigned per class.
Multiple "Coordinators" can be assigned per class.
Multiple "Subject Teachers" can be assigned per subject.
"Class Teachers" and "Coordinators" have access to all subjects within their assigned class.
"Subject Teachers" have access only to the specific subject(s) they are mapped to.
important_notes: The "Display Name" of a subject can be adjusted here, which is what students will see.
